description: This file defines CLI commands for managing users in the LiteLLM proxy server, utilizing the click library for command-line interface creation and rich for output formatting. It includes commands for listing, getting, creating, and deleting users, and interacts with an external UsersManagementClient.

methods.name: users()
methods.description: CLI command group for user management

methods.name: list_users(ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Lists all users and displays them in a formatted table

methods.name: get_user(ctx: click.Context, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves and displays information for a specific user by ID

methods.name: create_user(ctx: click.Context, email, role, alias, team, max_budget)
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified parameters

methods.name: delete_user(ctx: click.Context, user_ids)
methods.description: Deletes one or more users by their user IDs

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.pattern: /^def create_user(ctx: click.Context, email, role, alias, team, max_budget):$/
ctags.signature: (ctx: click.Context, email, role, alias, team, max_budget)
